_note: Food through paid vouchers usable only at eating joints: as PERQ-MEAL-AT-WORK, the excess over the limit per meal is salary (D-117). TY 2025-26: "fifty rupees per meal", and the limit "shall not apply to an employee … who has exercised an option under sub-section (5) of section 115BAC or whose income is chargeable to tax under sub-section (1A) of section 115BAC" (Rules 1962 r.3(7)(iii) second proviso, G.S.R. 452(E), Gazette 246719, read) — so this version is ExceptIn NEW_TAX_REGIME, and there a voucher is valued in full under PERQ-MEAL. TY 2026-27: "₹200 per meal" in every regime — S4 and S2 were searched for any such bar and none was found (r.15(5) Table IV Sl. 3 col. D (a), Gazette 271092, p.1546).
